recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a dead-man's-switch heartbeat to nightly-sync using hosted healthchecks.io, so the user is alerted if no ping arrives by about 03:30.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to find out when `nightly-sync` dies instead of discovering it by accident; nobody asked for log aggregation, that's a proposed means.
labels.Deleted: a central log server / Docker log stack (ELK, Loki, etc.) — you said you won't read logs, so a nicer log doesn't close the gap that bit you.
labels.Bottleneck: the only failure signal today is the success email sent at the end of the script; a crash before that point produces zero signal.
labels.Checked myself: you told me the four crashes were an expired token at startup, before the email step, and nothing else watches the job.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat and offers self-hosted Docker only as a discouraged fallback for users who want no external dependency, so it counts as SMALL.
